state:
Goal `core-str-3-3`: `Core\Str::replaceRange` and `Core\Str::reverse` have every feature proof on
disk — description, three examples, attack, bench record, Rust tests with `covers:` markers, and a
plain-words card. `replaceRange` writes its result once through `built` at its exact length.
`reverse` no longer collects a list of every grapheme first: `granularity::Pieces` walks from the
back as well (`DoubleEndedIterator`). Every `Core\Str` perf record was re-measured after `str.rs`
changed, so the three dossier checks are red only on the members still owed below.

items.text: **`Core\Str::slice`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). It reads its window through `window`, the same one `replaceRange` uses, so the attack can reuse the far `int` offsets. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:2711`

**`Core\Str::split`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Check whether it collects its parts outside the memory limit before it builds the array. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:2048`

**`Core\Str::startsWith`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); a scalar result, so its bench declares `// bench: allocations 0`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:1961`

backlog: `Core\Str::trim`, `trimStart`, `trimEnd`, `upper`, `upperFirst` and `wrap` still owe all of `rule:testing/feature-proofs` (`bun nv proofs --owed --group 'Core\Str'`).
Every change to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs` makes every `Core\Str` perf record stale; end each session that touches it with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Str'` after verify is green.
